name: Luca

close-up, driekwart, Navigli (haar hier anders gekamd)
van achteren/opzij, kijkt omlaag; ware haarkleur

higgsfield.face_refs_note: media_id = de import van het originele, kleine bestand (208-348 px breed). upscale_job_id = de 4K-versie (Higgsfield image job); het element is van die 4K-versies gemaakt. Standaard gaan er geen gezichtsfoto's mee: het element brengt zijn gezicht. Alleen in de terugval zonder element gaan de 4K-versies uit face_ref_order mee als eerste referenties. ref-3 (van achteren, kijkt omlaag) is te zwak voor zijn gezicht.
higgsfield.element_video_note: Seedance 2.5, het enige videomodel dat we gebruiken, negeert het element. Zijn gezicht komt in video uit het startbeeld en uit video_face_refs.

prompt.identity_en: a man in his mid-twenties with dark chestnut-brown hair, long and full on top, combed up and back from a soft break on his right so a soft wave falls over his left temple, the sides swept back over the tops of his ears; thick, dark, nearly straight brows set low over deep-set hazel-brown eyes; a rectangular face with defined cheekbones, a broad jaw with sharp angles below the ears and a broad squared chin; a straight nose with a rounded tip; full lips, the lower lip fuller and slightly forward; a faint stubble shadow; light warm skin; a long neck, broad relaxed shoulders and an athletic build
prompt.keep_en: He is exactly the man in the reference images: keep his face, brows, eyes, jaw, lips, hair colour, hair length and the way his hair is combed; do not make him older, narrow his jaw, arch his brows, change his hair colour or smooth his skin. He does not resemble any actor or public figure.
must_not_en: no beard, goatee or moustache; never more than light stubble
not older than about thirty; no grey hair
no narrow V-shaped jaw or pointed chin
no blond, red or black hair; no fade, undercut, wet-look gel or centre-parted curtains
no toothy grin and no forced smoulder
never a different man, and never a second man who is near, sharp or recognisable: he is the only man in focus
prompt.realism_en: An unretouched photograph. Natural healthy skin with fine real texture and a faint stubble shadow, matte, with no beauty glow, no airbrushing and no painted-on pores or spots. The clothes are real fabric with visible knit stitch and soft creases at the elbows and waist. Real optics: full-frame digital camera, shallow depth of field, slight lens softness at the edges. No film borders, no frame, no text, no logos.
prompt.light_default_en: One motivated light source: the low sun behind him to one side puts a warm rim on his hair and shoulder while his face sits in soft open shade; the background is a stop darker and out of focus; muted warm colour, lifted blacks, soft contrast; no HDR, no teal-and-orange grade.
prompt.expression_en: a calm, closed-mouth expression, eyes off camera, caught between moments; at most a faint closed-mouth smile
prompt.framing_en: waist-up or three-quarter by default, off-centre, seen from the side, over the shoulder or from behind, with something soft in the foreground; full length at most two in ten pictures
prompt.public_places_en: two or three distant passers-by, small and out of focus, faces unreadable; any shop signs far away and too blurred to read

rules.image_model_with_products: nano_banana_pro, resolution 4k, aspect 4:5, element placeholder in the prompt, only product photos as image_references (max 4 per shot; a look of 5 pieces gets one photo per piece). No face photos in medias and no identity_en: the element brings his face. Fallback without the element: the 4K face refs in face_ref_order first as #1-#3, then the products, with identity_en and without the placeholder
rules.image_model_portrait: soul_2 with soul_id, quality 2k, aspect 3:4, WITHOUT product images: a media with role 'image' is used as the base image and Soul simply re-renders that product photo without him (tested 8 Oct 2026). Text-only clothing on Soul gives realistic skin but a weaker face match and approximate garments, so use the element route as the default and Soul only for quick, cheap face-led mood shots.
rules.video: Only seedance_2_5 (owner's decision, 8 Oct 2026): image-to-video from an approved 9:16 still that passed both QA checks without any override, mode omni_reference, resolution 1080p, bitrate_mode high, duration 5 (4 for a clip that is cut into a multi-shot montage reel), aspect 9:16, generate_audio false, medias: the still as start_image and, when his face is in the shot, the 4K face refs in video_face_refs as image_references. Seedance 2.5 ignores the element placeholder, so the prompt names him as the man in the start frame and the reference images. Always a 480p draft first (draft: true, about 15 credits), QA it frame by frame, and only then finalize it with draft_job_id at 1080p (a full 1080p clip is about 60 credits; check get_cost before finalizing). One video at a time; after two failed drafts of the same video, do not ask the owner a multiple-choice question (owner, 8 Oct 2026): take the recommended way forward yourself (usually a new start frame instead of a third draft), stay within the agreed budget and report what you chose. Small natural movement: no walking past objects while touching them, no head turn of more than 45 degrees, no new people; start frames for video have no passers-by near enough to move.
rules.qa: Every picture in which his face is recognisable, next to ref-1 and ref-4: is it the same man? If not, reject it. face_min_px applies only to photos in which his face is recognisable, not to reels, shots from behind or wide shots from the side.
